package.name: speech2plan_msgs
package.description: The skills between Speech2Plan and the plan executive: submitting the tasks people give, and asking people for help while carrying them out.

export.skill: id: carry_out_intent version: 1.0.0 description: | Build the plan of an intent whose places name entities of the world, and perform it, asking people for help through ask_for_help. Feedback names each step as it starts and whether the robot waits for people or asks for help; the result lists what happened at the tray. interface: action default_interface_path: /skill/carry_out_intent datatype: speech2plan_msgs/action/CarryOutIntent functional_domains: - navigation parameters: in: - name: intent type: object required: true description: | The hri_actions_msgs/Intent to carry out, __intent_move_to__ or __intent_bring_object__. - name: meta.priority type: integer default: 128 description: Between 0 and 255. out: - name: result.error_code type: integer description: ROS_ENOERR once the plan was performed.

id: ask_for_help version: 1.0.0 description: | Ask the people around the robot a question they answer with yes or no: to load or unload the tray, or whether to try a failed step again. interface: action default_interface_path: /skill/ask_for_help datatype: speech2plan_msgs/action/AskForHelp functional_domains: - communication parameters: in: - name: text type: string required: true description: What the robot says, ending in the question. - name: problem type: string required: true description: load_tray, unload_tray or step_failed. - name: person_id type: string default: "" description: If targeting a specific person, the ID of the person. out: - name: yes type: boolean description: Whether the answer was yes.
